svg.title: Analysis, native narration and safe placement
svg.desc: Snapshot source + nonsecret settings; record provider / model identity and durable checkpoints. Verify local YAMNet asset; measure speech / vocal protection independently; add supplied captions. Selected vision route: Gemini video or bounded sampled images; consent precedes external processing. Validate whole observation chunk; keep source event / recurrence / uncertainty; retain rejected evidence. Measure native host voice or explicit OpenAI WAV; fit inside safe event at up to 1.15x. No fit: pause at source event | uncertainty: unresolved | human review checks facts and missed events
